frozen_scope.break_even: (candidate_fit-reference_fit)/(reference_service-candidate_service) if denominator>0,clamped at zero; otherwise no finite faster-service crossover; descriptive paired5-unit ranges without an inferential gate.
frozen_scope.formula: Per-unit trusted fit-phase seconds + R*measured complete service seconds; full process-startup/worker wall separately disclosed; fitted parameters/calibration reused only in this declared scenario.
frozen_scope.reuse_unit: One complete fixed service workload per unit,all3K,updates0/1/4 at a single noise; repeating fresh workloads of the same measured sizes,not a count of individual queries.
frozen_scope.scope: Descriptive,not a new gate or selection criterion
frozen_scope.truthfully_charged_once: No R multiplier on fit,update subsets not double counted; full every-arm grids/fit plus evaluation/testing charged to programme.
